brief.meaningEn: Reveal or suggest a history, experience or meaning through details of an object or collection; a museum or archive may also help a place tell its story through supported local evidence.
brief.meaningZh: 透過物件或一組資料的細節，呈現或暗示背後的歷史、經歷或意義；博物館或檔案館亦可藉有根據的地方資料，協助一個地方呈現其歷史。
brief.grammar: Worn steps or photographs tell a story about a place; a museum can help a city tell its story. Told/tells/telling are natural inflections, and its refers to the place. Objects and places do not literally speak: dated details support an account without proving every person’s motive or a complete history.
brief.register: Figurative but natural in museum and civic writing. A curator may tell visitors what dated objects show; a city historian may explain how an archive helps the town tell its story. Identify visible evidence before claiming a personal motive.
brief.boundaryZh: 物件或地方可透過有年份的資料呈現部分經歷，但這不是把城市當作真人說話，也不等於知道每個人的動機或完整歷史。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把單一磨損當作動機的證明，也不因物件不能說話，就認為它完全沒有資訊。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用具體物件或地方資料呈現有根據的歷史片段，分清可見證據與仍需查證的個人原因。

listening.en: The worn handles and repeated repairs tell a story about how often the community used the old cupboard, but they do not identify who made each repair; the curator plans to ask former volunteers before naming anyone.
listening.zh: 磨損的把手及反覆修補的痕跡，呈現社區經常使用舊櫃子的經歷，但沒有指明每次由誰修補；策展人打算先問昔日義工，再寫出人名。
listening.promptZh: 物件細節支持甚麼？還需要查問哪些資訊？

options.en: The cupboard shows repeated use and repair, while the repairers’ identities remain to be checked.
options.zh: 櫃子顯示反覆使用及修補，但維修者身份仍待核實。

options.en: Each mark is already linked to a named volunteer in the account.
options.zh: 敘述已把每道痕跡，連到一位具名義工。

options.en: The visible marks come from a single recent repair rather than repeated community use.
options.zh: 可見痕跡來自最近的一次修補，而不是社區反覆使用。

options.en: The curator plans to replace the cupboard before examining any of its details.
options.zh: 策展人打算還未查看細節，就先換掉櫃子。

listening.explanationZh: 痕跡支持使用經歷，卻未提供修補者姓名；策展人計劃查問，不是未看細節就換櫃。

reply.promptZh: 策展人為甚麼暫時不寫修補者的人名？
reply.promptEn: Why is the curator not naming the repairers yet?

options.en: The repairs tell a story of use, but do not identify the people who made them.
options.zh: 修補呈現了使用經歷，但沒有指明由誰完成。

options.en: The visible traces establish maintenance, not which volunteer carried out each part.
options.zh: 可見痕跡顯示曾經維護，卻沒有說每個部分由哪位義工處理。

options.en: Former volunteers may know something that the worn handles alone cannot supply.
options.zh: 昔日義工可能知道磨損把手本身不能提供的資訊。

options.en: Naming a repairer requires more information than the marks currently provide.
options.zh: 要寫出維修者姓名，需要比現有痕跡更多的資料。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都解釋了物件細節為甚麼尚不足以支持姓名，同時承認可見使用痕跡仍有價值。

scene.promptZh: 市鎮檔案館展出有年份的店舖招牌及租約，顯示市集如何改變，但沒有記錄每家店為何結業。哪句最審慎？

options.en: The dated records help the town tell its story by showing how the market changed, but they do not establish why each shop closed.
options.zh: 有年份的紀錄顯示市集如何變遷，有助小鎮呈現自身歷史，但不能證實每家店為何結業。

options.en: The leases prove that every shop closed because its rent rose, even though no reason is recorded.
options.zh: 雖然沒有記下原因，租約仍證明每家店都是因租金上升而結業。

options.en: Because the records leave motives unknown, the town cannot tell any story about how its market changed.
options.zh: 既然紀錄沒有交代動機，小鎮就完全無法呈現市集如何改變。

scene.explanationZh: 有年份的招牌及租約可支持市集變遷的敘述，但不足以證實每家店的結業原因；不能把未知動機當作已知，也不用因此否定所有可見變化。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不能從物件 tell a story 的比喻本身推論出來？

options.en: Details can suggest past use or change.
options.zh: 細節可以暗示過去的使用或改變。

options.en: Every person’s motive and every event are already known.
options.zh: 每個人的動機及每件事情，都已經知道。

options.en: Other testimony may clarify the object’s history.
options.zh: 其他證言可能釐清物件的經歷。

contrast.explanationZh: 呈現部分經歷，不等於已完整知道所有事件及動機。

dialogue.promptZh: 伙伴問：「看到修補痕跡，就可以直接寫是林先生做的嗎？」還沒有人認出維修者。哪個回應最好？

options.en: The repairs tell a story, but not yet that particular name; let us ask the former volunteers first.
options.zh: 修補呈現了一段經歷，但尚未支持那個特定人名；先問昔日義工吧。

options.en: I would name him now because he volunteered there, even though nobody has linked him to the repairs.
options.zh: 我會現在寫他，因為他曾在那裏做義工，雖然沒有人把他與修補連起來。

options.en: We should remove all mention of repairs until we know the person’s name.
options.zh: 在知道姓名之前，應刪掉所有有關修補的描述。

dialogue.explanationZh: 可以保留已看見的修補，但不添加未證實的姓名；不必因一項未知，就抹去已見的細節。

speaking.en: These marks tell a story about past use, but I would look for more evidence before naming the people behind them.
speaking.zh: 這些痕跡呈現過去使用的經歷，但寫出背後人物的姓名前，我會再找證據。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明痕跡支持甚麼，以及仍有甚麼未知。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：人物整理自己童年的畫冊，看到同一隻貓畫了很多遍，旁邊有祖父寫的鼓勵。你想以第一人稱旁白呈現練習及被支持的成長，不把畫冊當成全家每人的完整人生。用一至兩句英文寫實際旁白。
writing.selfCheckZh: 以畫冊中的反覆練習及鼓勵，寫出可用的第一人稱旁白；保留自己的記憶及細節，不用局部物件取代全家的完整經歷。

examples.en: These pages tell a story about the child I was: I drew the same cat again and again, with my grandfather’s encouragement beside it. Turning the pages, I can see practice and kindness sharing the same small space.
examples.zh: 這些頁面呈現了童年的我：同一隻貓，我畫了一遍又一遍，旁邊有祖父的鼓勵。翻着頁，我看見練習與善意共在同一片小空間。

examples.en: The repeated cats and his careful notes tell a story of how I kept trying. I cannot find our whole family history here, but I can recognise the support that made these attempts possible.
examples.zh: 反覆畫出的貓，及他用心寫的字句，呈現了我怎樣不斷嘗試。這裏沒有全家的完整歷史，但我認得那些讓嘗試成為可能的支持。

glossary.en: the support that made these attempts possible
glossary.zh: 讓這些嘗試成為可能的支持

takeaways.en: The patched sleeves tell a story of long use, though the label does not say who sewed them.
takeaways.zh: 補過的衣袖呈現長期使用的經歷，但標籤沒有說由誰縫補。

takeaways.en: The notes in the margins told a story of changing plans as the writer reconsidered the ending.
takeaways.zh: 作者重新考慮結尾時，頁邊筆記呈現了計劃改變的經過。

sources.sentence: From one trial, the ripples have spread much more widely.
sources.expression: ripples have spread much more widely

brief.meaningEn: Spread from an initial event or group to affect others; effects may ripple out, news may ripple through a city, and the resulting ripples may spread more widely through connected groups.
brief.meaningZh: 從最初事件或群體向外擴散並影響其他人；影響可向外傳開，消息可在人們轉傳下遍及城市，連鎖影響亦可擴至更廣範圍。
brief.grammar: Effects can ripple out/outward or through a connected family; reported news can ripple through a city. A change can send ripples far beyond its starting group, or its ripples have spread much more widely after identifiable follow-on effects. Name the initial cause and relay link; wider spread does not mean everyone experienced the same effect.
brief.register: Figurative water-movement image for good or bad effects. A project planner explaining a trial to residents can say its ripples have spread more widely after linked service changes; a news editor can describe information rippling through a city. Neither wording alone proves every claimed causal link.
brief.boundaryZh: 可用於「影響已擴得更廣」的名詞 ripples 加 spread 結構；仍須交代起點及後續連結，不能只因同時發生便當作連鎖影響。
brief.misconceptionZh: ripples have spread much more widely 是後續影響擴大的說法，不表示人人同時受相同影響，也不表示任何遠處變化都由原試行計劃引起。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描繪有依據的連鎖影響，並保留範圍差異。

options.en: A change at the library affected activity at a nearby business.
options.zh: 圖書館的改變影響附近店舖的活動。

options.en: The café’s earlier closure caused the library to reduce its hours.
options.zh: 咖啡店提早關門，令圖書館縮短時間。

options.en: The longer hours affected only the librarian’s desk arrangement.
options.zh: 延長時間只影響圖書館員的桌面安排。

options.en: The café’s customers changed independently of the study sessions.
options.zh: 咖啡店顧客的變化與溫習時段無關。

listening.explanationZh: 晚間圖書館使用增加，帶動之後到咖啡店的人流，是具體連結；不是反向因果或無關同時發生。
listening.en: The library’s longer opening hours rippled out to the nearby café, which began serving more students after evening study sessions.
listening.zh: 圖書館延長開放的影響擴散到附近咖啡店；晚間溫習後到店的學生增加。

reply.promptEn: How could the new repair classes benefit people beyond those who attend?
reply.promptZh: 新維修班可怎樣幫到直接參加者以外的人？

options.en: Participants might show family members how to fix small items.
options.zh: 參加者可能教家人修小物品。

options.en: The benefits could ripple out as learners share what they have practised.
options.zh: 學習者分享練過的技巧時，好處可能向外擴散。

options.en: Neighbours could borrow tools and learn from someone who took the class.
options.zh: 鄰居可向上過課的人借工具並請教。

options.en: Families could spend less on replacements when learners repair household items.
options.zh: 學員修理家居物品時，家人可減少花錢更換。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均提出直接學員以外的可能好處；金句保留 could，不保證所有人都受惠。

scene.promptZh: 某區試行夜間接駁車後，轉乘乘客增加。鄰近診所為了讓這些乘客趕上晚間預約，調整了預約時段；社區中心也因應他們到訪而延後關門。哪句最準確？

options.en: The ripples have spread much more widely: the trial led clinics to revise booking slots and the community centre to stay open later.
options.zh: 連鎖影響已擴得更廣：試行計劃令診所調整預約時段，社區中心也延後關門。

options.en: The community centre extended its hours first and caused the shuttle trial, rather than responding to extra transfers.
options.zh: 社區中心先延長時間，促成了接駁車試行，而不是回應轉乘人流增加。

options.en: The extra transfers affected only the shuttle route; the clinics and community centre kept their original schedules.
options.zh: 轉乘人流增加只影響接駁路線；診所及社區中心仍維持原來安排。

scene.explanationZh: 轉乘人流增加後，診所及社區中心相繼調整，構成從試行路線向外擴展的具體連結；不是相反的先後次序，也不是影響只限於原路線。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個推論不宜單憑 ripple out 作出？

options.en: An effect can reach beyond its starting point.
options.zh: 影響可超出最初起點。

options.en: Connections can transmit an effect to other groups.
options.zh: 連結可把影響傳到其他群體。

options.en: Every person must experience the same effect at the same time.
options.zh: 每個人必須在同一時間有相同影響。

contrast.explanationZh: 擴散範圍、時間及效果可不同，沒有全體同時一致的保證。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「兩間店同日生意變了，就是同一影響擴散吧？」哪句較準確？

options.en: Effects can ripple out, but we should check what connects the changes before claiming a link.
options.zh: 影響可以向外擴散，但說有連結前，應查甚麼把變化連起來。

options.en: Use the matching dates as enough evidence without checking customer patterns.
options.zh: 只因日期相同就當證據足夠，不查顧客模式。

options.en: Describe one shop’s change as the cause before asking whether the shops share customers.
options.zh: 未問兩店是否有共同顧客，就說一店改變是另一店的成因。

dialogue.explanationZh: 同時發生不等於因果，要查顧客或其他實際連結。

speaking.en: The benefits can ripple out when participants share their new skills.
speaking.zh: 參加者分享新技能時，好處可向外擴散。
speaking.promptZh: 你想描述分享帶來的間接好處。先聽，再說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：學生學會節約食物，回家和家人分享，家人再把做法帶到工作場所。用一至兩句英文描述影響怎樣擴散。

examples.en: The lessons can ripple out as students share food-saving ideas with their families. Family members may then try them at work.
examples.zh: 學生與家人分享節約食物想法時，課堂影響可向外擴散。家人之後可能在工作場所嘗試。

examples.en: The benefits ripple out through family conversations and workplace habits, rather than staying only in the classroom.
examples.zh: 好處透過家庭談話及工作習慣向外擴散，而非只留在課室。

writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出由學生到家人再到工作場所的傳播連結；可用 can 或 may 保留未必人人實行。

takeaways.en: A small change can ripple out through a connected community.
takeaways.zh: 小改變可透過互相連結的社區向外擴散。

takeaways.en: One timetable change can send ripples far beyond the first team when other groups depend on its deliveries.
takeaways.zh: 若其他小組依賴第一組的送貨，一項時間表改動便可能令影響擴散到遠超第一組的範圍。
